# scm_cngfw_gcp_link (Resource)

Links a Google Cloud tenant to a Strata Cloud Manager TSG for Cloud NGFW for GCP. Creating this resource generates a one-time link code, which the customer enters in the Google Cloud console when creating a firewall endpoint. The code expires after 48 hours. Destroying this resource unlinks the firewall endpoint created with the code. A code that was never used is not revoked: it stays valid until it expires. Changing any argument forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This file is embedded using go:embed
# Link a GCP project to the TSG in the provider scope. tsg_id and csp_id are
# read-only: the link service fills them in from the provider credentials.
resource "scm_cngfw_gcp_link" "project" {
  gcp_tenant_id = "projects/my-gcp-project"
}

# Link a GCP organization, storing the link in the europe region.
resource "scm_cngfw_gcp_link" "organization" {
  gcp_tenant_id = "organizations/123456789012"
  region        = "europe"
}

# Hand the link code to whoever creates the firewall endpoint in Google Cloud.
output "gcp_link_code" {
  value     = scm_cngfw_gcp_link.project.link_code
  sensitive = true
}

output "gcp_link_code_expires_at" {
  value = scm_cngfw_gcp_link.project.expires_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gcp_tenant_id` (String) The GCP tenant to link: `organizations/{number}`, `projects/{project ID or number}`, a bare number, or a bare project ID (6-30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter). It must match the tenant the customer selects in the Google Cloud console exactly.

### Optional

- `region` (String) The Cloud NGFW region the link is stored in, sent as the `x-panw-region` header. If unset, the API gateway default is used.

### Read-Only

- `csp_id` (String) The Customer Support Portal account ID of the TSG, as looked up and returned by the link service.
- `expires_at` (Number) When the link code expires, in Unix epoch seconds.
- `id` (String) The GCP tenant ID.
- `link_code` (String, Sensitive) The one-time link code to enter in the Google Cloud console.
- `tsg_id` (String) The Tenant Service Group the GCP tenant is linked to: the TSG the provider credentials are scoped to.
